messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Adderall has a Boxed Warning for abuse, misuse, and addiction.
Abuse, misuse, and addiction:
Adderall has a high chance of abuse and misuse and may lead to substance use problems, including addiction. Misuse and abuse of Adderall, other amphetamine-containing medicines, and methylphenidate-containing medicines can lead to overdose and death. The risk of overdose and death is increased with higher doses or when the medicine is used in ways that are not approved, such as snorting or injection.
Adderall may lead to physical dependence after prolonged use, even if taken as directed. Your healthcare provider should check you or your child for the risk of abuse, misuse, and addiction before starting treatment and will monitor you or your child during treatment. Tell your healthcare provider if you or your child has ever abused or been dependent on alcohol, prescription medicines, or street drugs.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
